visual: Bushy annual with upright wiry stems, softly hairy green leaves and distinctive rounded, clover-like flower heads formed from papery coloured bracts.
water: Water regularly while establishing, then moderately.
soil: Fertile, free-draining; Cold wet soil rots it; frost kills it
prune: No formal pruning required. Deadhead or regularly cut flower stems to encourage continued flowering.
cvs: Species supplied without a named cultivar.
resilience: Very tolerant of summer heat and increasingly drought tolerant once established, but killed by frost.
uses: Summer bedding, sunny borders, containers, pollinator planting, fresh cut flowers and everlasting dried flowers.
hardinessNote: Tender to frost in the UK and normally grown as a half-hardy annual.
foliage: herbaceous; green, opposite, oblong leaves, often softly hairy, on a bushy annual plant.
